# Target bytes at 0x402030
target = bytes([0x1a, 0xee, 0xaf, 0x68, 0x0d, 0x9b, 0x36, 0xb8, 0x67, 0xa7, 0xb1, 0x0e, 0x02, 0xbd, 0x2b, 0xde, 0x4e, 0xe5, 0xa6, 0x6a, 0xf7])

# Starting value of edx (dl = 0x5c = 92)
edx = 0x5c

# We need to find input such that (input[i] ^ edx) == target[i]
# So input[i] = target[i] ^ edx
# After each iteration, edx = (edx + input[i]) & 0xFF  (lower 8 bits)

flag = []
for i in range(21):
    input_byte = target[i] ^ (edx & 0xFF)
    flag.append(input_byte)
    edx = (edx + input_byte) & 0xFFFFFFFF  # edx is 32-bit but we only care about low 8 bits for xor

print("Flag:", bytes(flag).decode('latin-1'))
print("Hex:", bytes(flag).hex())
